concerns.text: FR-004 requires measuring and recording inference latency for EACH scene. T012 only specifies outputting 'predictions.jsonl'. There is no task to generate a per-scene latency log (e.g., 'latency_log.jsonl') required to satisfy FR-004 and feed T016's median calculation.

Plan defines 'Distributional Validity Gate' (T007) as a hard blocking condition. T018 (main.py orchestrator) describes the pipeline flow but omits the logic to check the gate status and halt execution if T007 fails, risking invalid benchmark results.

FR-007 requires automatic exclusion of scenes with missing/malformed data and reporting the count. T013 only tasks error handling in 'run_solver.py' to log excluded scenes. It lacks a task to detect malformed data during extraction (T010) or ensure exclusion from the solver input set before processing.

SC-004 requires measuring the 'proportion of failure cases attributable to semantic disambiguation'. T021 only tasks the classification of failures. There is no explicit task to calculate and output the final proportion statistic in the report (T022).

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Plan require checksumming raw data. T006 implements 'huggingface_hub' fetching with 'FAIL LOUD' logic but lacks a task to verify the downloaded dataset's checksum against the manifest before proceeding, creating a gap for truncated/corrupted files.

SC-002 requires measuring latency against a VLM baseline. T019 generates 'benchmark_results.csv' but no task explicitly describes the mechanism to retrieve or load the pre-computed VLM baseline predictions and their latency data, which are external to the symbolic solver pipeline.
